function.name: GET_POINT
function.param: Number of graph inside of the library
Number of point of control (0 is the center)
Offset of a variable of entire type (INT) which will have the horizontal coordinate of the point
Offset of a variable of entire type (INT) which will have the vertical coordinate of the point
function.abstract: It allows to obtain a point of control of a graph

description.p: Any graph can contain a indetermined number of points of control where the point of control 0 is the center of the graph, and the rest is avaliable for the user. This function allows to know a point of control of any graph. If the number of the point of control specified is out of range, the function returns -1 and the variables x and y will not be modified. But if the point of control is, but it is not defined, x and y will have the value -1. In the rest of cases, x and y will have the coordinates of the point of control, then (0, 0) will represent the pixel located in the top left corner of the graph, and the coordinates will increase towards up an right.
